title: Circulating miRNAs for glioblastoma monitoring: from biofluid to clinical decision.
snippet: Gliomas, particularly glioblastoma (GBM), remain highly lethal brain tumors with limited treatments. MRI-based monitoring lacks specificity in distinguishing progression from treatment effects. Circulating microRNAs (miRNAs), small non-coding RNAs involved in tumor biology, show promise as liquid biopsy biomarkers. We searched PubMed, Embase, Scopus, and We...
